rca.defect: The convergence gate expected one controller and one inference span per unique request. The frozen deliberate idempotent replay correctly creates one additional controller-only span and no additional Triton inference or durable effect.
rca.remediation: Derive exact controller and inference cardinalities from the immutable unique request set plus the single replay record; validate original and replay controller parentage, identity, timestamps, source revision, and replay attributes independently.
